children: Peruvian monthly consumer prices rose 0.07% in August, according to data published on Tuesday by the national statistics agency INEI.
• Data came in a touch below the 0.1% median forecast in a Reuters poll, and compared with a 0.29% increase registered in July.
• Housing, water, electricity, gas and other fuels prices rose 0.87% in the month, while restaurants and hotels and transportation both gained 0.28%, INEI said.
• On the other hand, food and non-alcoholic beverages prices fell by 0.66%.
• Among food items, INEI highlighted the lower prices of meat products such as chicken.
• Annual inflation in Lima - the nation's main inflation benchmark - accelerated to 4.44% in the 12 months through August from 4.07% in July, remaining above the central bank's 1% to 3% target range.
